status: Authored by the promoted product-designer. Candidate: the owner accepts fidelity, not this record.

interactionContract.keyboard: All actionable controls are reachable in logical order with visible focus; Enter or Space activates only the focused control, never focus itself. Escape closes the defer editor without changing state.
interactionContract.pointer: Acknowledge and Defer activate only on click or explicit pointer activation. Pointer hover, press, or focus never commits an action.
interactionContract.acknowledge: From pending or deferred, explicit Acknowledge opens a confirmation step or commits deterministically; success records acknowledged, preserves an undo event, and restores focus to the status heading or undo control.
interactionContract.defer: Explicit Defer opens an editor requiring a bounded reason and a valid future review time. Empty, overlong, absent, malformed, or past values refuse submission and expose the named validation state beside the invalid field.
interactionContract.undo: Undo is an explicit keyboard- and pointer-activated action available after either transition. It records a separate undo event, restores the prior state deterministically, and returns focus to the restored action/status context.
interactionContract.failure: Saving exposes saving, then either the committed state or save-failed. Save failure preserves the user's input, announces the failure, and returns focus to the retry control without inventing state.
interactionContract.disabled: Disabled controls are skipped only when non-actionable, expose disabled semantics and an explanation, and cannot be triggered by keyboard or pointer.

artDirectionContract.surface: A compact warm matte office artifact: off-white plaster-like surface on a neutral ground, light wood or charcoal-metal framing, restrained contact shadow, and a 0.7px defining edge on solid faces. No glassmorphism, glossy gradients, dark neon, generic dashboard cards, or status-dependent scene lighting.
artDirectionContract.typography: Warm humanist sans-serif carries title, summary, labels, statuses, and actions. Restrained monospace is limited to decision IDs, timestamps, technical evidence paths, and provenance.
artDirectionContract.accent: One warm amber accent marks manager attention, keyboard focus, selection, and the primary action only. It never marks severity, role identity, lifecycle status, links, decoration, or ambient activity.
artDirectionContract.spacing: Use calm, generous grouping: title and status first, summary next, evidence and metadata in readable clusters, actions last. Preserve clear separation between lifecycle status, severity, validation, and evidence; avoid dense dashboard grids.
artDirectionContract.severity: Severity uses semantic shape, label, icon or rule treatment and approved semantic colors only; severity must never use the reserved amber accent or role branding.
artDirectionContract.accessibility: Maintain WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, visible focus, readable hierarchy, and meaning that survives greyscale and 200% zoom.

responsiveRules: At the approved desktop boundary, preserve the notice's readable single-column hierarchy and keep evidence and action groups distinct.
At narrower widths, stack metadata, evidence rows, validation messages, and actions; never hide status, severity, due date, or evidence state.
Keep primary and undo actions reachable without horizontal scrolling; allow long evidence names to wrap rather than truncate meaning.
At 200% zoom, preserve all content and operation within the approved desktop boundary without overlapping controls or requiring hidden hover content.
Use the approved viewport and browser matrix for final measurements; unlisted breakpoints are deferred until explicitly approved.
contentLengthRules: Decision title is concise and remains fully readable; do not replace it with an ellipsis that removes identifying meaning.
Summary is plain language and bounded to a short readable block; preserve the full text through wrapping or an explicit accessible expansion.
Decision IDs, ISO timestamps, artifact names, and provenance values may wrap or use controlled overflow, but must remain copyable and identifiable.
Evidence link accessible names include the artifact name and state; never use 'click here' or silently omit a failed link.
Deferral reasons have a documented maximum length; show remaining count and reject overlong input rather than truncate it.
Validation messages name the failed field and correction; do not rely on color, icon, or placeholder text alone.
Long locale-rendered dates and future review times wrap predictably without replacing the stored ISO-8601 UTC value.
reducedMotion: Remove all transitions, progress animation, avatar travel, parallax, and ambient motion; retain static progress and state markers.
State changes remain observable through immediate text, structure, icons, focus movement, and announcements rather than animation.
Do not use motion to communicate severity, role, or attention; the reserved amber accent and structural cues remain unchanged.
Saving, success, failure, validation, and undo feedback render immediately with deterministic clocks and no bounce or delayed reveal.
